    ## [Why does using ChatGPT still take me hours every week?](https://www.theautomatestack.com/blog/why-does-using-chatgpt-still-take-me-hours-every-week/)

    Because you start from a blank chat every time and re-explain your business, your voice and your offers. -   [How do I turn one idea into a week of posts?](https://www.theautomatestack.com/blog/how-do-i-turn-one-idea-into-a-week-of-posts/)

    ## [How do I turn one idea into a week of posts?](https://www.theautomatestack.com/blog/how-do-i-turn-one-idea-into-a-week-of-posts/)

    Start with one lesson you already teach, in three to six sentences. Give it to an AI tool with your voice and a rule not to invent anything, and ask for one newsletter, three short captions and three hooks. Edit them, add one real example, and spread them across your week.

-   [Why does everything I write with AI sound like AI?](https://www.theautomatestack.com/blog/why-does-everything-i-write-with-ai-sound-like-ai/)

    ai writing

    ## [Why does everything I write with AI sound like AI?](https://www.theautomatestack.com/blog/why-does-everything-i-write-with-ai-sound-like-ai/)

    Because AI can only reshape what you give it. Give it a thin idea and it hands back a thin, generic post. Feed it your own words, your own example and a few plain rules, then edit what comes back before you post.
